name: calc_black_scholes
description:
Black-Scholes prices of a European call and put on a non-dividend-paying stock. Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {call_price, put_price, d1, d2}, 4 decimals; no Greeks.
Inputs (* required): stock_price* (spot), strike*, time_years* (time to expiry in years, > 0, e.g. 0.5), risk_free_rate* (annual percent, continuous), volatility* (annual percent, > 0).
For dividends, American exercise or Greeks use qlrisk_price_equity_option.
Example: {"stock_price": 100, "strike": 105, "time_years": 0.5, "risk_free_rate": 4, "volatility": 25}
